patch_description:
The best prior program achieved 0.69 with only 5 distinct parameters through aggressive parameter sharing. The current program regressed to 6 distinct parameters by splitting initial RY into ry_even/ry_odd and keeping ent_lr separate from ent_nn.

This edit unifies parameters back to 4 distinct ones:
1. Merge ry_even and ry_odd → ry (single shared parameter for all initial rotations)
2. Merge ent_lr → ent_nn (all entanglers share one parameter, as recommended)

This reduces the parameter count from 6 to 4 distinct parameters while preserving the streamlined gate structure. Parameter economy is the primary differentiator per the scoring rules - fewer distinct parameters ALWAYS scores higher with no diminishing returns. The recommendation explicitly suggests this unification to probe the expressivity threshold that gave 0.69 with 5 parameters.
